summary: National Guard troops continue to be stationed in D.C. more than a year after their deployment, while advocacy groups emphasize the need for greater local control in the District. Statehood supporters are intensifying efforts ahead of the midterm elections, including engaging support at the state level and securing commitments from elected officials. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
